Google Play Data Safety & GDPR Article 17

Request Account & Data Deletion

TaskMate (Package: com.taskmate.app)

In compliance with Google Play's Data Safety Policy and GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure), users of TaskMate may request complete and permanent deletion of their account and all associated personal data.

What data will be permanently deleted?

Executing this request permanently erases your user credentials, personal profile, tasks, subtask checklists, uploaded file attachments, reminder schedules, and collaborative workspace memberships. This action cannot be undone.

Option 1: Immediate In-App Deletion (Recommended)

If you currently have access to the TaskMate application or web portal:

  1. Log in to your account at https://taskflow.zerosyntax.in or launch the TaskMate mobile app.
  2. Click on the Settings tab in the navigation sidebar.
  3. Scroll down to the Danger Zone section.
  4. Click Delete Account, type DELETE to confirm, and submit.
  5. Your account, sessions, and data will be erased immediately.

Option 2: Direct Email / Web Deletion Request

If you have uninstalled the application or cannot access your account, you can submit an automated deletion request directly by sending an email from your registered email address to:

Manual Deletion Processing Desk

Email: admin@zerosyntax.in
Subject: TaskMate Account Deletion Request
Body: Please include your registered email address.

All verified requests submitted via email are processed within 48 hours, after which all customer database records are expunged and a confirmation reply is returned.

Data Retention Policy

No personal or behavioral data is retained after deletion. Diagnostic logs containing anonymized IP addresses are rotated and permanently expunged every 30 days.
